plugins.name: DPS Meter
plugins.author: ImTheFakeOne
plugins.description: NotMeter-style live DPS for you and your party: target HP, class-coloured bars, combat power, damage share, fight history and screenshots, with settings for every part. Uses Daeva Hub's capture engine (from A2Tools); needs Npcap.
plugins.changelog: Fight history: 60 fights grouped into dungeon runs; tick fights or runs and save them as a JSON or CSV log for Aion 2 log sites. Needs Daeva Hub 0.6.0.

plugins.name: Aion 2 Checklist
plugins.author: ImTheFakeOne
plugins.description: Daily and weekly checklist for every character, split into PvE and PvP, with the official 07:00 UTC resets. You tick everything yourself.
